myths.label: The Schedule Fallacy
myths.myth_text: A GSA Schedule is all you need to win federal contracts.
myths.reality_text: GSA MAS is powerful — but it's one of 30+ GWACs and IDIQs. SEWP V dominates IT hardware and cloud. CIO-SP4 owns health IT. OASIS+ leads professional services. Right vehicle = right agency.

myths.label: The Primes-Only Myth
myths.myth_text: SEWP, CIO-SP4, and OASIS+ are only for large contractors.
myths.reality_text: Every major vehicle has a small business pool. SEWP V is open to any approved vendor. CIO-SP4 and OASIS+ have dedicated SB tracks. Getting in early means less competition than fighting on MAS alone.

myths.label: The More-Is-More Myth
myths.myth_text: The more vehicles you're on, the more federal business you'll win.
myths.reality_text: One vehicle, executed well, beats five managed poorly. Focus on 1–2 that match your NAICS codes and target agencies. Build past performance there first. Expand when you've won.

close.close_question: Drop the vehicle myth you believed when you first started pursuing federal contracts.
